name: CURRENCY
description: This entity identifies the name for the system of money.  Example: - U.S. dollars - Canadian dollars - Japanese yen

name: CURRENCY_DENOMINATION_TYPE
description: A code for the type of currency denomination such as $5, $10, $20, $100, and $500.

name: CURRENCY_SEGMENT
description: At some international banks, one of their Chart of Account (COA) segments is currency. They use the term "multicurrency" for their accounting system. name: CURRENCY_TRANSLATION_RATE
description: This is the entity that tracks the conversion rates for converting from one currency to another currency.  There is no single market source for currency exchange rates. name: CURRENCY_TRANSLATION_RATE_TYPE
description: The entity that indicates the type of currency translation.  Possible examples may be: - Minimum bid rate - Minimum ask rate - Average bid rate - Average ask rate - Maximum bid rate - Maximum ask rate

name: CURRENCY_USE_TYPE
description: This minor entity defines the uses that a currency may have. For example, when it is related to an account it may be the currency the statement is printed in or the currency that internal amounts related to that account are stated in.

name: CUSTOM_CALENDAR
description: This entity establishes an identity for a custom calendar. It allows for many custom calendars of varying types. For example, you could have many fiscal calendars or many crop calendars.

name: CUSTOM_CALENDAR_DAY
description: This entity assigns a Gregorian date to a custom calendar week, month, and year for a given custom calendar. name: CUSTOM_CALENDAR_MONTH
description: Defines the months belonging to a custom calendar. In the context of finance, it is a fiscal month, for example, "Fiscal Month 2."

name: CUSTOM_CALENDAR_MONTH_WEEK
description: This is a cross-reference mapping custom weeks to the month(s) they fall in.

name: CUSTOM_CALENDAR_QUARTER
description: Defines the quarters belonging to a custom calendar. In the context of finance, it is a fiscal quarter, for example, "Q1 Fiscal 2005."

name: CUSTOM_CALENDAR_WEEK
description: Defines the weeks belonging to a custom calendar. In the context of finance, it is a fiscal week, for example, "Fiscal Week 5, 2005."

name: CUSTOM_CALENDAR_YEAR
description: A CUSTOM CALENDAR YEAR defines a calendar year for a specific business purpose. name: DOMAIN_ROOT_TYPE
description: This is the extension name of the domain server sourced from the web log.  Examples: - .com - .net - .org

name: GEOGRAPHICAL_AREA_CURRENCY
description: This entity contains the currencies that are valid for this geographical area. For example, the currency for the United States is United States dollar (USD). Some countries can have multiple currencies such as Barbados uses United States dollar as well as Barbados dollar.

name: GEOGRAPHICAL_AREA_CURRENCY_ROLE
description: This is a code for the role that a currency has with a geographical area such as the primary currency or the currency that the country's currency is pegged to.

name: HOLIDAY_CALENDAR
description: This entity identifies a calendar that is used to determine business days. This is used in capital markets when determining next business day. It is not necessarily tied to a geographic area. Some holiday schedules are tied to security exchanges.

name: HOLIDAY_CALENDAR_DATE
description: This entity contains dates that are considered holidays and weekends. This is used in capital markets when determining next business day. It is not necessarily tied to a geographic area. Some holiday schedules are tied to security exchanges.

name: ISO_10962_CLASSIFICATION_OF_FINANCIAL_INSTRUMENTS

description: This is the coding scheme for this currency as assigned by the International Standards Organization 4217. name: ISO_LANGUAGE_TYPE
description: The ISO 639 standard for this language.  Examples: - Eng = English - Frp = Franco Provencal - Spa = Spanish

name: LANGUAGE_PROFICIENCY_TYPE
description: The natural method of language expression that a party may be proficient in.  Examples: - Speaking - Understanding (listening) - Reading - Writing

name: LANGUAGE_TYPE
description: This is a code for the method of written or spoken communication that is tied to world regions and cultures such as English, Spanish, German, and French.  Note: ISO 639 can be used as a standard identifier.

name: LANGUAGE_USAGE_TYPE
description: The way a LANGUAGE TYPE is used in a specific instance by a PARTY.  Examples: - Verbal communication - Written communication - Solicitation

name: LEGAL_CLASSIFICATION
description: The set of codes used in the legal classification of the businesses. Examples include sole proprietor, partnership, limited partnership, master limited partnership, corporation, S corporation, nonprofit, or trust.

name: METRIC_DOMAIN_TYPE
description: Identifies whether the metric is an amount, a rate, or a quantity.

name: PROJECT_CLASSIFICATION_TYPE
description: PROJECT CLASSIFICATION TYPE indicates whether the PROJECT involves parties outside the company. Internal projects are within the company only. description: This entity defines the fiscal year associated with a SET OF BOOKS. Each SET OF BOOKS will have a fiscal year, or accounting period covering 12 consecutive months. description: This entity relates a set of books to the base (or primary) currency used for that set of books. name: TIME_PERIOD_TYPE
description: This minor entity defines the code for a time period that is used in various places in the model. Values could be daily, weekly, monthly, and annually.

name: UNIT_OF_MEASURE
description: This is the unit in which the quantity or magnitude is expressed. It can apply to any business element requiring a unit of measure.
